title: Property
notes: The whole lot. A null id means Not set up: the model's field light follows the time of day (on from dusk to sunrise) and the hub is not called. Put the entity id in and a tap on the pole toggles the real light.

light_pole.note: No outdoor, yard or pole light was found in the hub mappings yet. Set this to the field light's entity (light.* or switch.* with switch.set).
